neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * You can now sign a member of your Claude Enterprise (claude.ai) organization out of Claude everywhere with the Admin API. This capability is in beta. See the [Admin API reference](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization). The member stays in the organization and can sign in again. See [Sign a member out everywhere](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/user-management#sign-a-member-out-everywhere) for the beta header and what the request doesn’t end.
